item.tib: bdud 'dul gsang ba'i bskang ba nor bu 'phring ba
item.coloph: bskang mtshogs (tshogs) nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di/ snying (snyigs) ma'i dus su mkha' 'gro ma'i (mas) skal ldan gshen la rgyud (brgyud) pa'o/ skal ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ phyi rab rabs) don du mdzod nag bkra shis khrod la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
